purpose: Permit successor tests to reconstruct and exercise the exact frozen R4 payload without reading changed V4 working-tree files or relying on a mutable remote ref.

generation.creator: /root
generation.content_policy: one exact commit and its reachable objects beyond the declared prerequisite

nonclaims: The bundle does not change or requalify R4.
The bundle does not grant execution, activation, release, deployment, or merge authority.
The bundle must be authenticated by raw SHA-256 before Git parses it.
rollback: Remove the V4-only bundle and its successor harness changes together; preserve the R4 qualification receipt and remote branch.
